words.note: mask를 동사로 = 감추다·가리다. 명사만 알면 아까운 단어!

words.ex: The baby is finally asleep.
use: He fell asleep during the movie.
My leg is asleep — it feels tingly!
mcq: She fell asleep on the sofa.
She fell into asleep on the sofa.
She slept asleep on the sofa.
Asleep she fell the sofa on.
words.note: fall asleep = 잠들다. '다리가 저리다'도 my leg is asleep — 재밌는 용법!

words.ex: The investigation is still ongoing.
use: We have an ongoing project with the city.
mcq: Support for the students is ongoing.
Support for the students is ongoing now still yet.
The ongoing is support for students.
Students are ongoing the support.
words.note: ongoing = 지금도 계속되는. ongoing process/support가 대표 짝!

words.ex: I beg you to reconsider.
use: The dog begged for food at the table.
개가 식탁에서 먹을 걸 조르며 애원했다.
mcq: He begged me to stay longer.
He begged me staying longer.
He begged that me stay longer.
He begged to me for stay.
words.note: beg + 사람 + to부정사. I beg your pardon(정중한 되묻기)도 세트로!

words.ex: The ball hit the ceiling.
use: There's a leak in the ceiling.
The budget has a ceiling of 5 million won.
mcq: Prices hit the ceiling last month.
Prices hit to the ceiling last month.
The ceiling hit prices last month.
Prices ceiling hit the last month.
words.note: '상한선' 뜻이 보너스 — price ceiling, glass ceiling(보이지 않는 승진 장벽)!
